cells.relief_encoding: base64 of 2 bits per cell, 4 per byte, low bits first

spines.name: western cordillera
spines.cause: coastal collision range; the rain shadow east of it is what §1a's badlands and desert require

spines.name: the great spine
spines.cause: the principal collision spine; the only ground above the snowline (§1a alpine glacier and tundra)

spines.name: northern uplands
spines.cause: an older, eroded range on the northern mass; §1a puts taiga in northern upland and nowhere else

spines.name: eastern escarpment
spines.cause: trailing-margin shoulder (§VII-C), not a collision: low, one-sided, and it fronts the continental interior
